patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layout for introductory text, featuring a large, left-aligned heading and narrow, justified text columns on the right.
Full-bleed image and video sections are used for project showcases, often with minimal text overlay or adjacent text blocks.
Editorial-scale hero typography with multi-line, large, bold sans-serif text on the left, contrasted with smaller, dense, justified body text columns on the right.
A sticky header containing navigation links remains fixed at the top of the viewport after the initial scroll.
Project sections reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport.
A circular hero image uses a scroll-triggered effect, appearing to stick or parallax slightly as the page scrolls, revealing more of the image behind the text.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that remains visible at the top of the screen after the initial scroll.
Scroll-triggered animations, likely using GSAP, are used to reveal new content sections with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport.

Hero imagery incorporates a scroll-based parallax or sticky effect, where a masked image appears to move at a different rate than the main content, creating depth and revealing more of the image as the user scrolls.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, multi-line hero headings (~4-5x body text) with small, tightly-packed body text columns.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in hero and between major sections, creating a sense of spaciousness; body text within columns is dense.

standout: The site's distinctive editorial layout, featuring an oversized, multi-line hero statement on the left paired with narrow, justified text columns on the right, immediately sets it apart. This, combined with the subtle scroll-triggered parallax on the hero image and full-bleed project showcases, creates a sophisticated, magazine-like portfolio experience that feels both minimal and impactful.
